newsitem.title: FRANCE: Elf sees H1 pre-exceptional up 35 pct. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Elf sees H1 pre-exceptional up 35 pct. [CORRECTED 16:50 GMT]

text.p: Elf Aquitaine said in a statement on Friday it expected first half pre-exceptional income (corrects from "first half pre-tax...") to be some 35 percent higher than last year but that this should not be extrapolated for the full year.
The forecast came in a statement by Elf chairman Philippe Jaffre to a shareholders meeting.
Elf said that during the first months of 1997, the refining and marketing sector's operations showed a noticeable improvement linked to an increase in refining margins and productivity gains.
Elf Aquitaine had a first half 1996 net attributable profit of 3.56 billion francs, up 24 percent.
